parks.name: Town Hall
parks.description: The town council meets here; the registry, the mayor's office and the council chamber upstairs.

parks.name: Parish Hall
parks.description: A hall for the parish: meetings, jumble sales and the Tuesday choir, with a kitchen for the tea.

parks.name: Church
parks.description: A stone church with a nave, a chancel and a vestry; open to all for a quiet moment.

parks.name: School
parks.description: Classrooms, a hall that is the canteen at lunchtime, a staff room and a playground.

parks.name: Police Station
parks.description: A front desk, offices, an interview room and two cells, mostly empty.

parks.name: Fire Station
parks.description: An engine bay with the engines ready to go, a watch room, a day room and the lockers.

parks.name: Medical Centre
parks.description: A waiting room, consulting rooms and a pharmacy counter.

parks.name: Leisure Centre
parks.description: A gym, a sports hall and changing rooms with showers.

parks.name: Bank

parks.name: Newspaper

parks.name: Works
parks.description: Open-plan offices, a lab, a server room and a meeting room.

parks.name: Solicitors
parks.description: A reception, two offices and a library of law books.

parks.name: Army Reserve Centre

parks.name: Garage

parks.name: Studios

parks.description: A dining room and a kitchen.
